name: SPY Technical Indicator Predictive Power Analysis
description: Tests short-term predictive power of technical indicators (RSI, MACD, SMA, Bollinger Bands) on SPY by analyzing forward returns when various signal conditions trigger
source:
# SPY Technical Indicator Predictive Power Analysis
# Tests short-term predictive power of RSI, MACD, SMA, and Bollinger Bands

# =============================================================================
# DATA SOURCE
# =============================================================================
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c
high = src.h
low = src.l

# =============================================================================
# TECHNICAL INDICATORS
# =============================================================================

# RSI(14)
rsi_14 = rsi(period=14)(close)

# MACD (12, 26, 9)
macd_line, macd_signal, macd_hist = macd(short_period=12, long_period=26, signal_period=9)(close)

# Moving Averages
sma_50 = ma(period=50, type=MAType.sma)(close)
sma_200 = ma(period=200, type=MAType.sma)(close)

# Bollinger Bands (20, 2)
bb_lower, bb_middle, bb_upper = bbands(period=20, stddev=2)(close)

# =============================================================================
# FORWARD RETURNS (using lead operator <<)
# =============================================================================
fwd_ret_1d = (close << 1) / close - 1
fwd_ret_3d = (close << 3) / close - 1
fwd_ret_5d = (close << 5) / close - 1

# Win conditions (positive returns)
win_1d = fwd_ret_1d > 0
win_3d = fwd_ret_3d > 0
win_5d = fwd_ret_5d > 0

# =============================================================================
# SIGNAL CONDITIONS
# =============================================================================

# RSI Signals
rsi_oversold = rsi_14 < 30
rsi_overbought = rsi_14 > 70

# MACD Crossover Signals
macd_bullish_cross = crossover(macd_line, macd_signal)
macd_bearish_cross = crossunder(macd_line, macd_signal)

# SMA Regime Signals
above_sma50 = close > sma_50
above_sma200 = close > sma_200
golden_regime = above_sma50 and above_sma200
death_regime = close < sma_50 and close < sma_200

# Bollinger Band Signals
bb_lower_touch = close <= bb_lower
bb_upper_touch = close >= bb_upper

# =============================================================================
# CONDITIONAL RETURNS BY SIGNAL
# =============================================================================

# RSI Oversold returns
rsi_os_win_1d = where(rsi_oversold, win_1d)
rsi_os_ret_1d = where(rsi_oversold, fwd_ret_1d)
rsi_os_ret_5d = where(rsi_oversold, fwd_ret_5d)
rsi_os_count = 1.0 if rsi_oversold else 0.0

# RSI Overbought returns
rsi_ob_win_1d = where(rsi_overbought, win_1d)
rsi_ob_ret_1d = where(rsi_overbought, fwd_ret_1d)
rsi_ob_ret_5d = where(rsi_overbought, fwd_ret_5d)
rsi_ob_count = 1.0 if rsi_overbought else 0.0

# MACD Bullish Cross returns
macd_bull_win_1d = where(macd_bullish_cross, win_1d)
macd_bull_ret_1d = where(macd_bullish_cross, fwd_ret_1d)
macd_bull_ret_3d = where(macd_bullish_cross, fwd_ret_3d)
macd_bull_count = 1.0 if macd_bullish_cross else 0.0

# MACD Bearish Cross returns
macd_bear_win_1d = where(macd_bearish_cross, win_1d)
macd_bear_ret_1d = where(macd_bearish_cross, fwd_ret_1d)
macd_bear_ret_3d = where(macd_bearish_cross, fwd_ret_3d)
macd_bear_count = 1.0 if macd_bearish_cross else 0.0

# Golden Regime returns
golden_win_1d = where(golden_regime, win_1d)
golden_ret_1d = where(golden_regime, fwd_ret_1d)
golden_ret_3d = where(golden_regime, fwd_ret_3d)
golden_ret_5d = where(golden_regime, fwd_ret_5d)
golden_count = 1.0 if golden_regime else 0.0

# BB Lower Touch returns
bb_low_win_1d = where(bb_lower_touch, win_1d)
bb_low_ret_1d = where(bb_lower_touch, fwd_ret_1d)
bb_low_ret_5d = where(bb_lower_touch, fwd_ret_5d)
bb_low_count = 1.0 if bb_lower_touch else 0.0

# Win rate conversions (boolean to numeric for aggregation)
rsi_os_win_num = 1.0 if rsi_os_win_1d else 0.0
rsi_ob_win_num = 1.0 if rsi_ob_win_1d else 0.0
macd_bull_win_num = 1.0 if macd_bull_win_1d else 0.0
macd_bear_win_num = 1.0 if macd_bear_win_1d else 0.0
golden_win_num = 1.0 if golden_win_1d else 0.0
bb_low_win_num = 1.0 if bb_low_win_1d else 0.0

# =============================================================================
# DASHBOARD CARDS
# =============================================================================

cards(
    layout=CardLayout(
        title="Technical Indicator Win Rates",
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(title="RSI Oversold Win Rate (1D)", card_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title="RSI Overbought Win Rate (1D)", card_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title="MACD Bullish Cross Win Rate (1D)", card_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title="Golden Regime Win Rate (1D)", card_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title="Avg 5D Forward Return", card_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    category="Summary"
)(rsi_os_win_num, rsi_ob_win_num, macd_bull_win_num, golden_win_num, fwd_ret_5d)

# =============================================================================
# DASHBOARD CHARTS
# =============================================================================

# SPY Price with Moving Averages
timeseries_lines(
    title="SPY Price with Moving Averages",
    category="Charts",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Close", color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="SMA 50", color=Color.Orange),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="SMA 200", color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(close, sma_50, sma_200)

# RSI(14) Indicator
timeseries_lines(
    title="RSI(14) Indicator",
    category="Charts",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="RSI", color=Color.Purple)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=30, title="Oversold", color=Color.Green, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        ReferenceLine(value=70, title="Overbought", color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ])
)(rsi_14)

# MACD Indicator
timeseries_lines(
    title="MACD Indicator",
    category="Charts",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="MACD Line", color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Signal Line", color=Color.Orange),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Histogram", color=Color.Gray)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title="Zero", color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ])
)(macd_line, macd_signal, macd_hist)

# Bollinger Bands
timeseries_lines(
    title="Bollinger Bands",
    category="Charts",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Close", color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="BB Upper", color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="BB Middle", color=Color.Gray),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="BB Lower", color=Color.Green, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ])
)(close, bb_upper, bb_middle, bb_lower)

# Forward Returns Distribution - 1D
histogram(
    title="1-Day Forward Return Distribution",
    category="Distributions",
    bins=50,
    x_axis_label="1D Forward Return",
    x_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    x_axis_dp=2,
    fill_color=Color.Blue
)(fwd_ret_1d)

# Forward Returns Distribution - 3D
histogram(
    title="3-Day Forward Return Distribution",
    category="Distributions",
    bins=50,
    x_axis_label="3D Forward Return",
    x_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    x_axis_dp=2,
    fill_color=Color.Orange
)(fwd_ret_3d)

# Forward Returns Distribution - 5D
histogram(
    title="5-Day Forward Return Distribution",
    category="Distributions",
    bins=50,
    x_axis_label="5D Forward Return",
    x_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    x_axis_dp=2,
    fill_color=Color.Green
)(fwd_ret_5d)

# =============================================================================
# DASHBOARD TABLES
# =============================================================================

# RSI Signal Statistics
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title="RSI Signal Statistics",
        row_size=2,
        col_size=4,
        row_headers=["RSI Oversold", "RSI Overbought"],
        col_headers=["Occurrences", "1D Win Rate", "1D Avg Return", "5D Avg Return"],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    category="Tables"
)(rsi_os_count, rsi_os_win_num, rsi_os_ret_1d, rsi_os_ret_5d, rsi_ob_count, rsi_ob_win_num, rsi_ob_ret_1d, rsi_ob_ret_5d)

# MACD Crossover Statistics
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title="MACD Crossover Statistics",
        row_size=2,
        col_size=4,
        row_headers=["Bullish Cross", "Bearish Cross"],
        col_headers=["Count", "1D Win Rate", "1D Avg Return", "3D Avg Return"],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    category="Tables"
)(macd_bull_count, macd_bull_win_num, macd_bull_ret_1d, macd_bull_ret_3d, macd_bear_count, macd_bear_win_num, macd_bear_ret_1d, macd_bear_ret_3d)

# Signal Performance Summary
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title="Signal Performance Summary",
        row_size=4,
        col_size=5,
        row_headers=["RSI Oversold", "MACD Bullish", "Golden Regime", "BB Lower Touch"],
        col_headers=["Count", "1D Win%", "1D Avg Ret", "3D Avg Ret", "5D Avg Ret"],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    category="Tables"
)(rsi_os_count, rsi_os_win_num, rsi_os_ret_1d, where(rsi_oversold, fwd_ret_3d), rsi_os_ret_5d, macd_bull_count, macd_bull_win_num, macd_bull_ret_1d, macd_bull_ret_3d, where(macd_bullish_cross, fwd_ret_5d), golden_count, golden_win_num, golden_ret_1d, golden_ret_3d, golden_ret_5d, bb_low_count, bb_low_win_num, bb_low_ret_1d, where(bb_lower_touch, fwd_ret_3d), bb_low_ret_5d)

# =============================================================================
# EVENT MARKERS
# =============================================================================

# RSI Oversold Events
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title="RSI Oversold",
        icon=Icon.TrendingDownIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title="RSI Value", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title="Close Price", type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="Signal", table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(rsi_14, close, rsi_oversold)

# RSI Overbought Events
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title="RSI Overbought",
        icon=Icon.TrendingUpIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title="RSI Value", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title="Close Price", type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="Signal", table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(rsi_14, close, rsi_overbought)

# MACD Bullish Cross Events
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title="MACD Bullish Cross",
        icon=Icon.ArrowUpIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title="MACD", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(title="Signal", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(title="Close Price", type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="Filter", table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(macd_line, macd_signal, close, macd_bullish_cross)

# BB Lower Touch Events
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title="BB Lower Touch",
        icon=Icon.ArrowDownIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title="Close", type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="BB Lower", type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="Filter", table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(close, bb_lower, bb_lower_touch)
